about: Content-Security-Policy violations the E2E collector (H-43, e2e/fixtures/playwright.ts and e2e/fixtures/csp.ts) already knows: each one is recorded and attached to the test, and does not fail it. A ratchet: an entry is added only by a recorded decision, with its reason and its owner, never to silence a red, and removed by the lot that cures it.

entries.reason: The inline script of frontend/src/app.html, in every page of the app: the theme before the first paint, the PWA install prompt, the service worker's registration.
entries.owner: H: the lot that hashes the inline scripts of index.html, after H-43 (D4)

entries.reason: SvelteKit's inline bootstrap script, which the SPA's index.html needs to start the app.
entries.owner: H: the lot that hashes the inline scripts of index.html, after H-43 (D4)

entries.reason: cheetah-grid 1.16.7 (both of its builds; it ships no ES module) bundles webpack's global probe, new Function("return this")(), inside a try/catch that falls back to window: harmless under an enforced policy. Seen by the first cloud smoke on the BRIM table preview (files.spec.ts). Until it is narrowed, this entry knows every eval.
entries.owner: H: the D4 lot narrows it ('report-sample' in CSP_REPORT_ONLY_POLICY, then a match on the sample «return this»); removed when cheetah-grid stops probing with eval

entries.reason: The address check of a link (Settings › Users) fetches <the address the admin typed>/api/v1/auth/address-probe, whatever its origin: admin-users.spec.ts AUSR-E-07 types other origins on purpose (127.0.0.1 for localhost, a closed port, an .invalid host). Under an enforced connect-src 'self', a probe of another origin than the page's would be blocked.
entries.owner: A (the probe's experience) + H (the enforcement lot: the configured public origin in connect-src, or a server-side probe)
